description:
These 4x4 terracotta bathroom tiles are square, natural handmade terracotta pieces measuring 4 x 4 inches, made for shower walls, niches and vanity splashbacks where a small, detailed tile suits the space.

## How they look
Handmade terracotta tends to vary slightly in shade and edge from tile to tile, so a wall of them looks warm and hand-finished rather than printed. The natural finish keeps the earthy clay colour without a glaze. At 4 inches, these small square terracotta tiles create a fine grid with many grout lines, which suits small washrooms and curved or narrow areas.

## Where they work
- **Shower niches and half-height walls**, where a small tile fits tight spaces with fewer cuts.
- **Vanity splashbacks** in handmade clay bathroom tiles, giving a rustic look behind a basin.
- **Feature strips** of natural terracotta wall tiles beside plain white tiles.

Unglazed clay is porous, so in a bathroom it works best once sealed; a good sealer generally keeps splashes and soap marks from soaking in, and the matte surface stays calm next to brass or black fittings.

## Good to know
- Size: 4 x 4 inches (as listed)
- Material: natural handmade terracotta
- Shape: square
- Category: bathroom wall terracotta tiles

Seal the tiles before grouting so grout does not stain the clay, then reseal as your fixer advises. Clean with a mild, pH-neutral cleaner; avoid acid cleaners.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to see the colour range of the 4x4 terracotta bathroom tiles, then get a dated quote. Compare with the [6x6 inch square version](/products/6x6-inch-square-natural-handmade-terracotta-bathroom-wall-tiles) or browse the [terracotta bathroom range](/categories/bathroom-wall-tiles-terracotta).

faqs.q: What is the price of 4x4 terracotta bathroom tiles?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can natural terracotta be used on a bathroom wall?
faqs.a: Yes, once it is sealed. Unglazed clay is porous, so a penetrating sealer before grouting and an occasional reseal help keep water and soap from marking it.

faqs.q: 4x4 or 6x6 terracotta tiles: which suits a small bathroom?
faqs.a: 4x4 tiles give a finer, more detailed grid and fit niches with fewer cuts; 6x6 tiles have fewer grout lines and look calmer on a full wall.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "4x4 Square Natural Terracotta" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
